from itertools import product
import re

# Extract all people names from the problem statement
problem_text = """
Mustafa Mickey Vina Phoebe Otis Oda Raymond Jerry Malcolm Mia Osborne Ovid Delbert Sal Octavia Orlando
Elanor Sherrie Mariah Miriam Mindy Natasha Shenna Conception Ozzy Maya Shaunda Max Odessa Bernita Sima
Maria Molly Orin Milo Andree Alexis Jamey Mackenzie Millie Crista Kandi Shalonda Muhammad Omar Lorine Teressa
Christie Ryan Fidel Yoland Bahar Maynard Amberly Mike Disha Antwan Ka Uri Ophelia Oprah Octavius Kandi
Tamika Murphy Osric Opal Mark Matteo Millicent Oleg Willian Melanie Mariana Martha Melanie
"""

all_people = sorted(list(set(re.findall(r'\b[A-Z][a-z]+\b', problem_text))))
person_idx = {p: i for i, p in enumerate(all_people)}
n = len(all_people)

print(f"Total people: {n}\n")

def check_constraints(assignment):
    """Check if assignment satisfies all constraints."""
    def truth(name):
        if name not in person_idx:
            return False
        return assignment[person_idx[name]]
    
    def count_truth(names):
        return sum(1 for name in names if truth(name))
    
    def check_claim(speaker, subject, positive):
        """Speaker says subject tells truth (positive=True) or lies (positive=False)."""
        if truth(speaker):
            return truth(subject) == positive
        else:
            return truth(subject) != positive
    
    # Mutual truth statements (both must be same value)
    pairs_same = [
        ("Malcolm", "Mia"), ("Osborne", "Ovid"), ("Oda", "Otis"), 
        ("Max", "Odessa"), ("Oleg", "Millicent"), ("Murphy", "Osric"),
        ("Ophelia", "Uri"), ("Muhammad", "Omar"), ("Mike", "Disha")
    ]
    for p1, p2 in pairs_same:
        if truth(p1) != truth(p2):
            return False
    
    # Mutual opposite statements (both must be opposite)
    pairs_opposite = [
        ("Mustafa", "Mickey"), ("Mariah", "Miriam"), ("Mindy", "Natasha"),
        ("Orlando", "Octavia"), ("Mark", "Opal"), ("Octavius", "Oprah"),
        ("Orin", "Milo"), ("Mackenzie", "Millie"), ("Bahar", "Maynard"),
        ("Melanie", "Mariana")
    ]
    for p1, p2 in pairs_opposite:
        if truth(p1) == truth(p2):
            return False
    
    # Simple claims
    simple_claims = [
        ("Mustafa", "Mickey", False), ("Mickey", "Mustafa", False),
        ("Elanor", "Sherrie", True), ("Shenna", "Conception", False),
        ("Ozzy", "Maya", False), ("Maya", "Ozzy", False),
        ("Sima", "Delbert", False), ("Maria", "Molly", False),
        ("Andree", "Alexis", False), ("Matteo", "Molly", True),
        ("Lorine", "Bernita", True), ("Crista", "Kandi", True),
        ("Christie", "Teressa", False), ("Alexis", "Jamey", True),
        ("Melanie", "Martha", True), ("Mariana", "Martha", False)
    ]
    for speaker, subject, positive in simple_claims:
        if not check_claim(speaker, subject, positive):
            return False
    
    # Amberly is given as a liar
    if truth("Amberly"):
        return False
    
    # Complex statements - either/or conditions
    # 2. Vina: exactly 2 of {Phoebe, Otis, Oda} or none
    c = count_truth(["Phoebe", "Otis", "Oda"])
    if truth("Vina") != ((c == 2) or (c == 0)):
        return False
    
    # 3. Raymond: exactly 1 of {Jerry, Mickey, Mustafa}
    c = count_truth(["Jerry", "Mickey", "Mustafa"])
    if truth("Raymond") != (c == 1):
        return False
    
    # 6. Delbert: exactly 1 of {Sal, Octavia, Orlando}
    c = count_truth(["Sal", "Octavia", "Orlando"])
    if truth("Delbert") != (c == 1):
        return False
    
    # 14. Shaunda: all 3 lie OR 2 tell truth of {Elanor, Mia, Malcolm}
    c = count_truth(["Elanor", "Mia", "Malcolm"])
    if truth("Shaunda") != ((c == 0) or (c == 2)):
        return False
    
    # 16. Bernita: exactly 2 of {Sima, Maya, Ozzy}
    c = count_truth(["Sima", "Maya", "Ozzy"])
    if truth("Bernita") != (c == 2):
        return False
    
    # 21. Jamey: exactly 1 of {Raymond, Bahar, Maynard}
    c = count_truth(["Raymond", "Bahar", "Maynard"])
    if truth("Jamey") != (c == 1):
        return False
    
    # 23. Phoebe: all 3 lie OR 2 tell truth of {Amberly, Odessa, Max}
    c = count_truth(["Amberly", "Odessa", "Max"])
    if truth("Phoebe") != ((c == 0) or (c == 2)):
        return False
    
    # 24. Shalonda: exactly 2 of {Crista, Omar, Muhammad} or none
    c = count_truth(["Crista", "Omar", "Muhammad"])
    if truth("Shalonda") != ((c == 2) or (c == 0)):
        return False
    
    # 26. Teressa: only one of {Shalonda, Matteo, Maria} lies
    lies = sum(1 for name in ["Shalonda", "Matteo", "Maria"] if not truth(name))
    if truth("Teressa") != (lies == 1):
        return False
    
    # 28. Sal: exactly 1 of {Andree, Opal, Mark}
    c = count_truth(["Andree", "Opal", "Mark"])
    if truth("Sal") != (c == 1):
        return False
    
    # 30. Ryan: exactly 1 of {Fidel, Millie, Mackenzie}
    c = count_truth(["Fidel", "Millie", "Mackenzie"])
    if truth("Ryan") != (c == 1):
        return False
    
    # 32. Tamika: all 3 tell truth OR only 1 of {Lorine, Disha, Mike}
    c = count_truth(["Lorine", "Disha", "Mike"])
    if truth("Tamika") != ((c == 3) or (c == 1)):
        return False
    
    # 39. Antwan: exactly 2 of {Ka, Uri, Ophelia} or none
    c = count_truth(["Ka", "Uri", "Ophelia"])
    if truth("Antwan") != ((c == 2) or (c == 0)):
        return False
    
    # 40. Yoland: exactly 2 of {Christie, Osborne, Ovid} or none
    c = count_truth(["Christie", "Osborne", "Ovid"])
    if truth("Yoland") != ((c == 2) or (c == 0)):
        return False
    
    # 41. Jerry: exactly 1 of {Antwan, Oprah, Octavius}
    c = count_truth(["Antwan", "Oprah", "Octavius"])
    if truth("Jerry") != (c == 1):
        return False
    
    # 43. Kandi: exactly 2 of {Shaunda, Mindy, Natasha}
    c = count_truth(["Shaunda", "Mindy", "Natasha"])
    if truth("Kandi") != (c == 2):
        return False
    
    # 48. Fidel: exactly 2 of {Yoland, Miriam, Mariah}
    c = count_truth(["Yoland", "Miriam", "Mariah"])
    if truth("Fidel") != (c == 2):
        return False
    
    # 52. Willian: all 3 lie OR 2 tell truth of {Vina, Millicent, Oleg}
    c = count_truth(["Vina", "Millicent", "Oleg"])
    if truth("Willian") != ((c == 0) or (c == 2)):
        return False
    
    # 55. Conception: exactly 2 of {Ryan, Milo, Orin}
    c = count_truth(["Ryan", "Milo", "Orin"])
    if truth("Conception") != (c == 2):
        return False
    
    # 56. Sherrie: exactly 2 of {Tamika, Murphy, Osric} or none
    c = count_truth(["Tamika", "Murphy", "Osric"])
    if truth("Sherrie") != ((c == 2) or (c == 0)):
        return False
    
    # 64. Ka: only one of {Willian, Melanie, Mariana} lies
    lies = sum(1 for name in ["Willian", "Melanie", "Mariana"] if not truth(name))
    if truth("Ka") != (lies == 1):
        return False
    
    return True

# Find all valid solutions
solutions = []
for assignment in product([False, True], repeat=n):
    if check_constraints(assignment):
        solutions.append(assignment)

print(f"Found {len(solutions)} solution(s)\n")

if len(solutions) == 1:
    solution = solutions[0]
    print("Unique solution:")
    tamika_truth = solution[person_idx["Tamika"]]
    sherrie_truth = solution[person_idx["Sherrie"]]
    shenna_truth = solution[person_idx["Shenna"]]
    
    print(f"Tamika: {'yes' if tamika_truth else 'no'}")
    print(f"Sherrie: {'yes' if sherrie_truth else 'no'}")
    print(f"Shenna: {'yes' if shenna_truth else 'no'}")
elif len(solutions) > 1:
    tamika_vals = {sol[person_idx["Tamika"]] for sol in solutions}
    sherrie_vals = {sol[person_idx["Sherrie"]] for sol in solutions}
    shenna_vals = {sol[person_idx["Shenna"]] for sol in solutions}
    
    tamika = "yes" if len(tamika_vals) == 1 and True in tamika_vals else ("no" if len(tamika_vals) == 1 else "unknown")
    sherrie = "yes" if len(sherrie_vals) == 1 and True in sherrie_vals else ("no" if len(sherrie_vals) == 1 else "unknown")
    shenna = "yes" if len(shenna_vals) == 1 and True in shenna_vals else ("no" if len(shenna_vals) == 1 else "unknown")
    
    print(f"Tamika values: {tamika_vals} -> {tamika}")
    print(f"Sherrie values: {sherrie_vals} -> {sherrie}")
    print(f"Shenna values: {shenna_vals} -> {shenna}")
